verdict.rationale: Restate documents durable event-driven triggers — webhooks, external events, durable timers/scheduling, and human-approval signals that can kick off durable actions (restate-docs-5, restate-docs-6, restate-docs-20, restate-docs-21) — which supports 'actions triggered automatically on events'. However, this is imperative code wiring to events/webhooks/timers rather than a declarative 'rules' engine (no conditional rule definitions, rule UI, or rule matching engine is evidenced). Missing for 10: a declarative rules/condition-definition mechanism, evidence of rule-based (vs. purely code-triggered) automation, and independent hands-on confirmation of event-triggered workflows in practice.
